label.description: Stable int32 class label encoded from the source label values.

label_name.description: Source label value as a string (see label_mapping in metadata.json).

sample_id.description: Stable row identifier matching the row index of features.npy.

preprocessing: Upstream: Target y == 'yes'; remaining columns one-hot encoded with pandas.get_dummies; stratified subsample with sklearn train_test_split(train_size=0.05, random_state=42) -> 2,059 rows. Features are then MinMax-scaled to [0, 1] as float32 (see https://github.com/mespadoto/proj-quant-eval/blob/9f14239f87bbacc6cac6ff52729284dd65956dd6/code/01_data_collection/get_datasets.py). Here: features cast to float32, labels encoded by sorted unique label name to int32.
source_name: Espadoto et al. (2021) DR survey benchmark
source_publication: M. Espadoto, R. M. Martins, A. Kerren, N. S. T. Hirata, A. C. Telea. Toward a Quantitative Survey of Dimension Reduction Techniques. IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics 27(3), 2021. doi:10.1109/TVCG.2019.2944182
